_comment: Mahjong Solitaire screenshot capture. 500-level CAMPAIGN (valid loadLevel indices 0-499, display level = idx+1). Every slot is a gameplay board at a distinct level and a table theme: window._mjShot(idx,theme,k,{hint,sel,hc,sec}) applies Mahjong Solitaire's real theme palette (window._MJ_THEMES: board-a/board-b/tile-side/tile-side-dark/tile-bone/sel) + midnight chrome, loads the level and plays the first k pairs of its stored clearing order through the real tap handler (mid-solve, never the last pair, so no win card), then optionally lights a solver Hint pair, selects one free tile, or turns on high-contrast tiles. Phone ships 7, tablets 2 each.
_readiness_expr: typeof save !== 'undefined' && typeof loadLevel === 'function' && typeof showScreen === 'function' && typeof PIPE_COLORS !== 'undefined' && typeof mjTap === 'function' && Array.isArray(window._MJ_THEMES)
